subject: Invoice not received
body: Hi I have not received my invoice for last month. Can you please send it to my email? I need it for accounting purposes.

subject: Double charge on my account
body: I was charged twice for my subscription this month. Please refund one of the payments immediately.

subject: Unable to update payment method
body: When I try to update my credit card details on the portal it gives an error saying invalid card number but the card is valid.

subject: Refund request for cancelled subscription
body: I cancelled my subscription 3 days ago but I have not received any refund yet. It has been more than 72 hours.

subject: Billing cycle confusion
body: I signed up on the 15th but I am being charged from the 1st. My billing cycle seems wrong please fix this.

subject: Tax invoice required
body: Our company requires a GST compliant tax invoice for all payments. Can you provide that?

subject: Overcharged this quarter
body: The amount charged this quarter does not match the plan I am on. I am on the basic plan but was charged premium rates.

subject: Payment failed but money deducted
body: My payment failed on checkout but the money was still deducted from my bank account. Please help.

subject: Need receipt for reimbursement
body: I need an official receipt for my purchase last week for expense reimbursement at my company.

subject: Discount not applied
body: I had a coupon code but the discount was not applied at checkout. I still paid full price.

subject: App crashes on startup
body: The mobile app crashes every time I try to open it. It shows a white screen and then closes automatically. I have tried reinstalling.

subject: API rate limit exceeded
body: We keep hitting the API rate limit even though we are well within our plan limits. Something seems wrong on your end.

subject: Login not working
body: I cannot login to my account. It keeps saying invalid credentials even though I am entering the correct password.

subject: Data export failing
body: When I try to export my data as CSV it gets stuck at 0 percent and never completes. I have tried multiple times on different browsers.

subject: Integration with Slack broken
body: Our Slack integration stopped working after the update last week. We are no longer receiving notifications.

subject: Dashboard not loading
body: The analytics dashboard takes forever to load and then shows a blank page. This started happening yesterday.

subject: 2FA not sending code
body: I enabled two-factor authentication but I am not receiving the verification code on my phone. Please help.

subject: File upload size limit
body: I am trying to upload a 50MB file but it says maximum file size is 10MB. Is there any way to increase this?

subject: Webhook not triggering
body: Our webhook endpoint is configured correctly but it is not being triggered when events happen.

subject: Search functionality broken
body: The search bar returns no results for anything even for things I know exist in the system.

subject: Leave application process
body: I want to apply for 5 days of casual leave next month. Can you tell me the process to submit a leave request?

subject: Salary slip not received
body: I have not received my salary slip for this month. Please send it to my official email address.

subject: Work from home policy query
body: Can you please share the updated work from home policy? I want to know how many days per week I am allowed to work remotely.

subject: PF withdrawal query
body: I want to know the process for withdrawing my PF balance. I am leaving the company next month.

subject: Performance review schedule
body: When is the performance review cycle starting this quarter? I want to prepare in advance.

subject: Joining formalities incomplete
body: I joined the company last week but I have not received my laptop or access credentials yet.

subject: Medical insurance claim
body: I need help filing a medical insurance claim. My family member was hospitalized last month.

subject: Training schedule request
body: Is there any upcoming technical training or upskilling program I can enroll in?

subject: Office access card issue
body: My access card stopped working. I cannot enter the office. Please issue a new one or fix the existing one.

subject: Appraisal letter not issued
body: My appraisal was finalized 2 months ago but I still have not received the official appraisal letter.

subject: Product roadmap enquiry
body: Can you share the product roadmap for Q3? I want to know what features are coming up.

subject: Partnership proposal
body: We are interested in a partnership with your company. Who should we contact to discuss this further?

subject: Feature request
body: I would love to see dark mode in the application. Many users have requested this as well.

subject: Account deletion request
body: I want to permanently delete my account and all associated data. Please tell me how to do this.

subject: How to upgrade plan
body: I am currently on the free plan and want to upgrade to pro. What are the benefits and how do I switch?

subject: Referral program details
body: Do you have a referral program? I want to refer my colleagues and would like to know how it works.

subject: Data privacy question
body: How is my personal data stored and processed? I want to understand your data privacy practices.

subject: Language support query
body: Does your platform support languages other than English? Specifically I need Hindi and Spanish.

subject: Mobile app availability
body: Is there a mobile app available for Android? I could not find it on the Play Store.

subject: Documentation request
body: Can you share the complete API documentation? The existing docs seem incomplete and outdated.

subject: Urgent payment failed system down
body: The payment system is completely down and I cannot process any transactions. This is urgent please help immediately.

subject: App not working at all broken
body: The entire application is not working. None of the features are loading. This is a critical issue.

subject: Need salary details urgent
body: Urgent requirement I need my salary certificate today for a loan application at the bank.

subject: Subscription plan comparison
body: Can you explain the difference between the basic pro and enterprise plans in detail?

subject: Server error 500 on checkout
body: Getting a 500 internal server error every time I try to checkout. This is preventing all our sales.

subject: GST number update on invoice
body: I need to update the GST number on all future invoices. How do I do this from my account settings?

subject: Password reset email not coming
body: I requested a password reset but the email never arrived. I checked spam also.

subject: Maternity leave policy
body: I am expecting and want to understand the maternity leave policy and how to apply for it.

subject: Company newsletter subscription
body: I want to subscribe to your company newsletter to stay updated on new features and announcements.

subject: Report downloading issue
body: The monthly report is not downloading properly. It shows an error after 90 percent completion.
